scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A counterexample to integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-integer-degree-harmonic-dimension-comparison-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 361 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6adbdbf2331bf0f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are an even integer n ≥ 8, an integer k ≥ 2, and a complete smooth metric g on Rn such that Ricg ≥ 0 and hk(Rn , g) > hk(Rn , gE). The metric is Euclidean near the origin, and its asymptotic volume ratio satisfies 0 < lim R→∞ volg Bg(0, R) ωnRn < 1, where ωn is the volume of the Euclidean unit ball.
